allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on August 24, 2026 - Allotment of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value of ₹ 10/- each at an issue price of ₹ 215/- per Rights Equity Share on rights basis

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Letter of Offer - Rights Issue'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: The Board at its meeting held on July 31, 2026 has approved various matters in connection with the Rights Issue, including but not limited to terms and conditions of the Rights Issue, determination of the issue price, rights entitlement ratio, record date, timing of the Rights Issue

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 31, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 19 : 295, i.e 19 Equity Shares for every 295 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 215 per share.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Draft Letter of Offer - Rights Issue'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Approval of Funds Raising by way of Rights Issue

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on Jun 30, 2026 - Approval of fund raising by way of Rights Issue
